paper.title: Fill on paper, assess online
paper.lead: For proposers who find a web form hard: print the form, fill it by hand, photograph it and let the AI read it. A person checks every value before the assessment runs.
paper.print_help: One A4 page in the language you have chosen, with English underneath. It asks only about the property and its risks, so no names, phone numbers or signatures go on paper or into the photo.
paper.upload_form: Photograph this page and upload it to Imaarat. Do not write names or phone numbers on it.
paper.digits_hint: Write one digit per box for the PIN code. Write amounts in rupees, digits only. Leave a box empty if you do not know.
paper.step_upload: Upload a photo of the form
paper.upload_help: Take the photo in good light, flat and straight, with all four corner marks visible.
paper.consent: I understand this demo reads the photo with Google's free Gemini API, which may use uploads to improve Google's products, so the photo must not show personal details.
paper.read_failed: The form could not be read. Try a clearer photo or type the details instead.
paper.ai_off: AI form reading is switched off on this demo. You can still print the form, and the details can be typed into a new assessment.
paper.review_help: Compare each value with the photo and correct it if needed. Confirm the PIN code, year built and amounts before you continue ({pending} left to confirm).
paper.issue_not_an_option: Not one of the form's options
paper.model_note: Read by {model}. Handwriting accuracy has not been measured yet, so every value needs a human check.
paper.prefilled: These values came from a paper form. Check every field, then assess.
how.title: From property details to a review-ready assessment
how.lead: Understand the risks, see the evidence and know what needs a closer look. AI helps read and explain information when enabled; the assessment follows fixed rules, not AI judgment.
how.s1.title: 1 · Provide property details
how.s1.body: Type the details or print a form and fill it by hand. When AI reading is enabled, upload only the property page and check every value it reads before continuing.
how.s2.title: 2 · Check the evidence
how.s2.body: The PIN code links to indicative earthquake zones, recorded flood history and district cyclone information. When enabled, AI also examines a property photo and finds relevant guidance. Maps do not replace a site survey.
how.s3.title: 3 · See the assessment
how.s3.body: Fixed rules produce a score from 0 to 100 and a recommendation. A higher score means greater concern, not a probability of loss. When AI is enabled, it explains the result and cites the guidance used; it cannot change the decision.
how.s4.title: 4 · Review referrals
how.s4.body: Cases marked for review wait for an underwriter to accept or change the recommendation. A change requires a written reason. This demo does not issue an insurance policy.
how.d1: You can see the assessed risks and supporting evidence. AI assistance is optional; fixed assessment rules still work when it is unavailable.
how.d2: The interface and printable form offer 26 languages. PIN-code maps provide regional context, not building-level certainty. Translations need review by native speakers.
how.d3: This is an open-source prototype, not an insurer's approved rating model. It makes no claims about faster processing, handwriting accuracy or improved claims outcomes.
how.r1: Use sample data only. Do not upload personal or confidential information. Google's unpaid AI service may use inputs and outputs to improve its products, and human reviewers may process them.
how.r2: The interface language does not change the AI explanation: AI risk summaries currently remain in English. Voice assistance is not available.
how.industry_note: These sources inform the design; they do not certify this prototype, its map accuracy or regulatory compliance.
